Majestic with Bengawalk.about: The team at Bengawalk reached out to me to make a small webapp for smoother navigation at the BMTC Majestic Bus Stand, This went alongside their updates to the physical signage at the bus stand.

Livebus / KIA-Live with Bengawalk.about: We wanted to try integrating live data into the kia website that Bengawalk has, upon numerous iterations we ended up with this webapp.

Transitrouter with Vonter.about: I extensively use this tool, so I've significantly contributed to it. Ranging from adding features, metrorail layers, datasets, and other contributions.

BMTC Platforms.about: I had found it difficult to navigate large BMTC bus stands, so I made a webapp in 2024 December. I revamped the design to match my work with Bengawalk on the Majestic tool in early 2026.

GTFS View.about: I work with quite a few gtfs datasets, so I created a small visualisation utility to view these datasets at a glance.

Mumbai Bus GTFS.about: I compiled numerous sources to generate a GTFS dataset to the best of my ability, this attempts to cover a large part of MMR.

PMPML GTFS.about: I compiled available sources to generate a GTFS dataset to the best of my ability. This tries to cover operations by Pune Mahanagar Parivahan Mandal Limited (PMPML)

Hubli-Dharwad BRT GTFS.about: I compiled available sources to generate a GTFS dataset to the best of my ability. This tries to cover operations by Hubli-Dharwad BRTS Company (HDBRTS)

Rajkot BRT GTFS.about: I compiled available sources to generate a GTFS dataset to the best of my ability. This tries to cover operations by Rajkot Rampath Limited (RRL)

Ahmedabad Bus GTFS.about: I compiled numerous sources to generate a GTFS dataset to the best of my ability, this attempts to cover a large part of Ahmedabad.

Jaipur Bus GTFS.about: I was approached by a potential developer for an ITS related requirement for Jaipur. They wanted GTFS data to showcase their software capabilities to the transit agency. I helped them procure the initial data for them to work off of.

BMTC Platforms GeoJSON.about: I did ground surveys to collect geographic information about large bus stations, then built a small dataset by compiling available sources as well as my ground surveys. This is what my Majestic and BMTC Platforms projects are built atop.

BMTC Screens.about: I made and used a tool for viewing upcoming arrivals of BMTC buses. Now Transitrouter has this functionality baked in, thus making this tool obsolete.
